title: Principal Private Secretary, Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, Tribunal Master, Assistant, Junior Accountant, Stenographer, Upper Division Clerk, Lower Division Clerk, Data Entry Operator, Staff Car Driver & Multi Tasking Staff
organization: Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh
age_limit: Not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of application
summary: Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh has issued a vacancy circular inviting applications for various posts including Principal Private Secretary, Tribunal Officer/Section Officer, Tribunal Master, Assistant, Junior Accountant, Stenographer, UDC, LDC, Data Entry Operator, Staff Car Driver, and MTS on deputation/absorption basis. A total of 57 vacancies are available across multiple pay levels. Interested and eligible candidates must submit their applications through proper channel latest by 22.01.2027.
eligibility_bullets: Deputation/absorption conditions apply based on the specific post requirements and parent department cadre rules.
Maximum age limit shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.
Educational qualifications range from 10th Pass, 12th Pass, Diploma/ITI, to Graduate degree depending on the applied post.
how_to_apply_steps: Ensure eligibility criteria for the desired post according to the official circular.
Fill out the prescribed pro-forma (Annexure-I) accurately with required details.
Attach photocopies of Annual Confidential Reports for the last five years and vigilance clearance certificate.
Forward the application through proper channel to the Registrar, Armed Forces Tribunal, Regional Bench, Chandigarh near Tank TCP, Chandimandir, Haryana-134107 latest by 22.01.2027.
pay_level: Pay Matrix Level 1 To Level 11 (7th CPC)
